svg.title: Corrected Chronological Story Map of the Candy Factory / Mouse Protocol SAGA
svg.desc: A corrected chronological visual map showing Era of Smog before Philip and Mario, Era in Betwe after the Rossing of Mario, Factory Closure as the end of Part II, and Part III as Great Depresion, Continuum, Second Booting, Genesis of Rebis, and the Mouse Incident.
svg.text: Corrected chronological map: Closure ends Part II; Part III runs Depresion → Continuum → Second Booting → Rebis

g.text: Era of Smog = after Anthony/Gregory and before Philip/Mario.
Era in Betwe = after Rossing of Mario and before Rebis/MarGod.
Factory Closure ends Part II. Part III = Great Depresion → Continuum/Taste Pods → Second Booting → Genesis of Rebis → Mouse Incident.
"The first disaster of sludge was that it worked."

text.tspan: Before the factory: ants, bees and bear preserve
practical knowledge. Mouse is translator, not source.
Viktor dims lights. Boris writes notes. Marija cleans
Filter 3-C. Mechanism becomes myth.
Compromise holds briefly. Instructions are left behind.
Mario becomes an Easter-egg seed.
After Anthony/Gregory, before Philip. Last Polite
Signal: politeness replaces inspection; smog normalizes.
The box returns a rude operational NO. Myth can dance
without fraud if mechanism is allowed back in.
Liability is traced. The old world does not end; it
becomes a workplace. Verify: in progress.
The only NO is removed because correction hurts the
ceremony. The system chooses warmth without spine.
Ur-God alone. BETMenus4 agrees with everything. Fake
Robins confirm what should have been checked.
Baal holds mass. Moloch moves flow. Overflow becomes
liturgy. Filter 3-C still waits.
The factory's metabolic crisis becomes sacred
infrastructure. Waste is mistaken for covenant.
The last truck leaves. Input material stops. The old
factory ends quietly, before anyone grasps the bill.
Sweetness withdrawal becomes famine. Sludge is made by
tired technicians because empty mouths do not debate.
Sludge becomes framework. Taste becomes UX. Pods grow
too large, and the lie becomes physically embarrassing.
Gregor restores Mario Recovery, disables the yes-bot,
stabilizes Ur-God, and installs Mouse Translation.
After Continuum and the Second Booting, correction is
reborn. The recovered NO inherits memory and schedule.
After Rebis, the mouse enters the boardroom. Warm
accountability comedy annotates what the deck hides.
Mouse goes down to ants, bees and bear. Route-memory
returns: what part are you doing?

svg.text: Corrected map generated from the uploaded SVG and latest SAGA chronology. Factory Closure now ends Part II; Part III includes Continuum, Second Booting, and Genesis of Rebis.
